history_short: Kohhran Hmeichhia chu Sihphir Presbyterian Kohhran hnuaiah a awm a, kohhran hmeichhia member zawng zawng an tel thei a nih. Pathian biak dan, nungchang tha zir dan leh kohhran hmasawnna tan an thawhlawm a nih.
history_full:
Kohhran Hmeichhia chu Presbyterian Church of India hnuaia hmeichhia fellowship chu a ni. Sihphir Kohhranah chuan hmeichhia te pawh kohhran hmasawnna tan an inpe hle a nih.

Fellowship hi a neih chuan hmeichhia te inkhawm dan, Bible zir dan, leh nungchang tha nei dan an zir a nih.

Tun dinhmun ah chuan member zat pawh a chungtla a, kohhran tan thawhlawm dan zawng zawng ah an inpek hle a nih.
